description.p: Soulless is a launcher for the COSMIC desktop, built by one stubborn veteran who decided everything on a computer should be findable from a single search box — apps, files, folders, CLI tools, Steam games, Flatpaks, Snaps, the whole lot. No hunting through menus. No five different places to look. One box, type, go.

It also does a few things most launchers don't bother with. The search learns as you go — the apps and tools you actually open float to the top, ranked by how often and how recently you reach for them, so the stuff you use is always one keystroke away. It keeps an eye on your Downloads folder too: drop a file in and Soulless works out where it belongs — pictures to Pictures, videos to Videos, that invoice to Finance — tells you why, and files it away with one click. It only ever suggests; nothing moves without your say-so.

And it makes CLI tools actually useful by launching their man pages — search a command, hit it, and read the docs instead of squinting at a bare name. Stash your sensitive files and apps behind an encrypted vault so they vanish from every menu on the system. Sort your tools into custom drawers that make sense to you. And keep an eye on your hardware with live network, CPU, GPU, RAM, and FPS readouts while you work.

ul.li: Search that learns — the more you use something, the higher it ranks, by frequency and recency
Smart download sorting — reads each new file, suggests where it belongs and why, files it with one click, and never moves anything without permission
Universal search — apps, files, CLI tools, Steam, Flatpak, and Snap, all at once
CLI tools that launch their man pages, so a command is actually useful and not just a name
Custom drawers to organize your tools the way your brain works, not the way a menu thinks it should
Encrypted vault that pulls sensitive files and apps off every system menu
Live hardware monitors — network, CPU, GPU, RAM, FPS
Your own backgrounds from ~/.config/soulless/backgrounds/
Disk-cached index so it opens the instant you hit the key
Full keyboard navigation — Tab, S, V, arrows, no mouse required
Super+Space from anywhere
wgpu-accelerated rendering because it's 2026
